title: Hungover Healing Greek Lamb Kleftiko
description: A traditional Greek dish featuring slow-cooked lamb in a rich beurre noisette sauce, served in a copper mug to help cure hangovers.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb pieces until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes, then remove from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the beurre noisette, lemon juice, dried oregano, salt, black pepper, and bay leaves to the pot, stirring to combine.
Return the lamb to the pot and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven, cooking for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender and falls apart easily.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly before serving the lamb in copper mugs.
